enabled.description: Whether the dependency is enabled. Objects of disabled dependencies are not merged into the chart.

mode.description: How the dependency is provided. `standalone` merges and deploys it with the chart, `operator` leaves it to an operator, so its objects are not merged into the chart. The credentials, wait init container and notes still apply.

password.description: Password used by the dependency. Defaults to `PLACEHOLDERPASSWORD`.

creds.description: Connection details populated by the dependency (eg `plainhost`, `url`). Read-only.

depconfig.description: Configuration of the dependency itself. Never merged into the chart values.

operator.description: Settings specific to the operator providing the dependency (see `mode`). Never merged into the chart values.

description: Configuration for `dependencies`. Each dependency contains a complete chart values structure. Its objects are merged into the chart under the name `<dependency>-<object>`.
